title: Why You're Broke 3 Days After Payday (5 Hidden Leaks)
alts: Living Paycheck to Paycheck? Here's Where Your Money Actually Goes
You Got Paid Friday. Why Is Your Account Empty by Monday?
line1: Why are you broke 3 days after payday? Dave gets $1,576 on Friday and has $38 by Monday. Here are the 5 leaks, and how to plug them.
summary: Dave gets paid on Friday and his account is almost empty by Monday, without one crazy purchase. We follow his paycheck through five leaks: taxes and deductions that shrink a $2,000 check to about $1,576, bills that all land on the first of the month, quiet subscriptions (people guess $86 a month, the itemized total is about $219), the payday spending spike measured in real bank data, and honest latte math versus housing and eating out (BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey). Then we look at who profits when you're broke (about $12 billion in overdraft and NSF fees in 2024), the Fed's $400 emergency question, and the simple system Dave used to keep $412 instead of $38.
